Meta.title: Orincard — Create Social Carousels with AI
Meta.description: Turn a topic, text, URL, video, PDF, or slides into editable LinkedIn, Instagram, and TikTok carousels. Design, brand, caption, and export in one workspace.

Nav.planMeta: No account is required to open the creator.

Marketing.headline: Turn what you know into a carousel worth saving.
Marketing.lead: Orincard helps you shape research, recordings, and rough ideas into editable visual stories for LinkedIn, Instagram, and TikTok.
Marketing.note: Open the creator without an account. Review every card before export.
Marketing.workflowTitle: The speed of generation, with room for your judgment.
Marketing.featureSourcesBody: Start with a topic, text, URL, video, PDF, or slide deck.
Marketing.featureEditBody: Refine the copy, layout, imagery, colors, and type before export.
Marketing.featureKeepBody: Save versions, reuse a Brand Kit, and restore portable project packages.
Marketing.formatsTitle: Compose for the feed you are publishing to.
Marketing.formatsLead: Choose a LinkedIn, Instagram, or TikTok preset. Orincard keeps the document editable and checks the export before it leaves your workspace.
Marketing.waitlistTitle: Want to hear when they open?

Pricing.headline: Start free. Join the paid-plan waitlist.
Pricing.lead: Paid plan pricing, allowances, payment platform, and launch regions are still being finalized. We will publish them only after they are approved.
Pricing.freeIntro: Start, edit, and learn the workflow before choosing a paid plan.
Pricing.proIntro: For a steady publishing practice with more creation and export options.
Pricing.creatorIntro: For creators producing more visual stories and video formats.
